title: A space set-point restore that fails on entering Off is never retried while Off
claim: If an off_restore write fails at the change into Off (a device briefly unreachable), it is not sent again over six hours of arbiter ticks and cycles after the device answers: the space set-point keeps the optimizer's gate (25, not the captured 45) and the heat-curve offset keeps +3 K (not the neutral 0), until a person toggles the optimizer or the entry unloads.
mechanism: off_restore.async_restore runs only from async_mode_change (the transition into MODE_OFF) and async_unload_entry; a failure is latched (off_restore_<key>) and left armed 'so the next off or unload tries again'. pump_arbiter._arbitrate returns at MODE_OFF without consulting the armed record, so no state reachable without a person leads to the write.

evidence.machine: box B11 (shared, up to three compute seats)
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats may share B11; the number is a count, contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: off_restore:_restore_baseline and off_restore:async_restore (latch off_restore_<key>, lines 220/253/256) via coordinator:HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator.async_set_mode, then pump_arbiter:apply/_arbitrate ticks

perturbation.change: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D16/s3/m5_holds.py --perturb retry_off_restore: an Off pass of pump_arbiter._arbitrate calls off_restore.async_restore first

metric_definition: Restore writes to the space set-point between the device recovering and six hours later, Off held, no person acting; key = entity_id of delivered service calls.
phenomenon_property: An armed off_restore entry whose restore failed is retried automatically while the optimizer stays Off (and while unloaded nothing can, so the unload path is the remainder), until it lands once.
seam_rule: grep -n 'async_restore\|async_mode_change' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/*.py (every caller; none runs per pass while Off)

null_control.note: without the failure the restore lands at Off and nothing more is written: the harness sees a restore when one happens

reproduction_steps: run the command; read writes_again_off_restore_failed_while_off and space_setpoint_final_while_off
person_toggle_restores=1 shows the only release is a person's Auto->Off toggle
proposed_fix_scope: Retry an armed, failed off_restore entry from the arbiter's one-minute tick (or a timer off_restore owns) while MODE_OFF, bounded, until it lands.
